AUTHORITY_REVOKED.description: Operating authority is REVOKED or INACTIVE by FMCSA. Load tendering prohibited.

CHAMELEON_CARRIER_AGE.description: Carrier registered USDOT number within last 90 days. High correlation with double-brokering and re-incorporation.

CHAMELEON_CARRIER_AGE_180.description: Carrier operating for less than 6 months. Subject to mandatory probationary safety audit.

INSURANCE_LAPSE.description: Commercial Auto BIPD or Cargo insurance has active cancellation notice on file with FMCSA.

HIGH_VEHICLE_OOS.description: Vehicle Out-of-Service inspection rate exceeds national average (>22.26%).

HIGH_DRIVER_OOS.description: Driver Out-of-Service inspection rate exceeds national average (>6.67%).

UNSATISFACTORY_SAFETY_RATING.description: FMCSA issued Unsatisfactory federal safety rating. Carrier cannot legally transport interstate freight.

CONDITIONAL_SAFETY_RATING.description: FMCSA issued Conditional safety rating. Significant compliance deficiencies detected.

FLEET_DRIVER_MISMATCH.description: Carrier reports active power units but 0 commercial drivers on file with FMCSA.

VIRTUAL_ADDRESS_DETECTED.description: Physical terminal address resolves to a commercial mail forwarding service (UPS Store, Regus, virtual office) rather than an operating truck yard.
